item.title: President Pezeshkian urges global accountability over environmental damage from US-Israeli attacks
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has called for stronger international mechanisms to document environmental damage caused by military actions and hold those responsible accountable, saying peace is essential to protecting the environment.

Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has called for stronger international mechanisms to document environmental damage caused by military actions and hold those responsible accountable, saying peace is essential to protecting the environment.
